doc_sources.note: Fetched 2026-08-20, HTTP 200. THE documentation host, and it is not the corporate site: www.acteongroup.com renders EMPTY over plain HTTP (JS/consent wall) while this one is static, unauthenticated and needs no browser. 5 category pages (equipement, imagerie, medical, veterinaire, pharma) -> ~129 product pages each -> per-product document lists. robots.txt allows all but /admin/. Downloads flow through dl.acteongroup.com (robots.txt 404, nothing disallowed). TWO ROUTE CLASSES: /qr/{id} is ungated and 302s to a PRESIGNED OVH S3 URL (X-Amz-Expires=3600), /register/{id} is form-gated. Presigned signatures change per request, so URL-keyed fetch dedupe false-negatives -- only content-hash dedupe works. The product page examined listed 17 documents and NO declaration of conformity or CE certificate.
